text:
maria_sales: Heads up team — Acme finance wants a POC in a completely isolated DC next quarter. They said no outbound, USB allowed for media transfer, and upgrades must be opt-in with signed deltas. Can we support? Pricing/contract asks coming too.

josh_se: short answer: yes, we can, but there are a few constraints. need to confirm image signing, SBOM, and runtime keys. also want to know sequence lengths and expected token volume for perf sizing.

taylor_infra: @josh_se +1. For installs we can provide an immutable installer tar + delta bundles. Shipping via USB is fine. We'll need a per-release signing key and a verification hook in the operator.

anika_security: USB transfer raises physical custody concerns. We'll need chain-of-custody checklist and signed-attestation for the delivered media. Also recommend HSM-backed signing and offline KMS sync plan.

maria_sales: customer asked about upgrade cadence — they prefer quarterly security patches, major upgrades every 6-12 months. Are delta bundles feasible at that cadence?

taylor_infra: yes. delta bundles are feasible. We do chunked diffs and an apply/resume capability. If they prefer smaller windows we can schedule monthly critical security deltas.

acme_it: quick Q from our side — will license enforcement work offline? we cannot call home. we need offline entitlement validation.

josh_se: we support offline license tokens that are time-limited and signed. process: you request an offline token, we sign it (issuer), you install it via the admin UI or CLI. token renewal can be handled via a signed renewal file shipped on media.

kevin_legal: note: offline token flow requires specific contract language (no automatic telemetry, audit log export restrictions). I'll draft a clause for the SOW.

anika_security: also recommend including a verification step: after install run: 

```
sha256sum redwood-installer.tar.gz && redwoodctl verify-signature --key <pub.pem> redwood-installer.tar.gz
```

This ensures media integrity before install.

deploy-bot: build/artifacts/redwood-2026-03-10 signed by release-key-2026 available at /artifacts/releases/2026-03-10 (internal only) :white_check_mark:

acme_it: ok good. one more — can we get a minimal-feature bundle for POC to reduce footprint? their DC has limited GPU capacity.

taylor_infra: we can produce a trimmed runtime: no model store, reduced metrics retention, single-node mode. we'll provide recommended quantized model and perf matrix.

josh_se: I'll prepare a short perf/cost calc for the trimmed bundle (tokens/sec, expected $/hr) and share by EOD.

maria_sales: thanks. action items: josh = perf + pricing calc, taylor = trimmed bundle spec + delta plan, anika = chain-of-custody checklist + signing ops, kevin = SOW language. acme_it please share expected qps and any compliance checklist.

acme_it: sending preliminary qps numbers and compliance PDF now. thanks all. :pray:

anika_security: flag — if they require HSM on-prem for signing keys, that adds procurement time. call it out in timeline.

taylor_infra: timeline note: production-ready offline packaging typically 6-8 weeks if no HSM. add 4-6 weeks if HSM required and we need to test integration.

maria_sales: perfect. I'll capture these in the deal doc and loop in AM for pricing. :thumbsup:
